name: Timeline
descriptor: The same list, grouped by month with a heading per month, newest first.
pros: months are how people remember, so the list reads like a history
a heading per month costs almost nothing and saves a lot of scanning
it is the same records as the plain list, seen differently
an empty month simply does not appear
cons: no year headings, so a long history is a long scroll
records without a date fall into a final group called Undated
no zoom from month to day
best_for: a record of things that happened, read backwards
avoid_if: the records are tasks rather than events
